purpose: Frozen confirmatory synthetic protocol; laptop-scale CPU only

programs.primary_comparison: recursive - fixed_author at C=128, B=32, each family
programs.secondary_comparisons: All prespecified checkpoints and budgets; no checkpoint selection on audit data
programs.score: Correct fraction on all 64 inputs of the actually released circuit
programs.matching: Equal numbers of policy evaluations and circuit evaluations. Wall time separately reported; not a claim of identical machine instruction counts.
programs.development_data: Separate training tasks and random streams per independent run; fixed within run
programs.audit_data: Fresh task/parent/search streams per independent run, shared only between paired regimes
programs.pilot_use: Runtime and software validation only; excluded from reported estimates

inference.replication_unit: Independent development run; average inner tasks before inference
inference.primary_finite_sample_interval: Bounded Hoeffding, simultaneous over 27 R-F cells
inference.descriptive_interval: Paired development-level Student t; asymptotic, not a finite-sample certificate
